chunks: 3947 - Al-Washsha' narrated from 'Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام say: “It is not proper for a man to advance ghee in exchange for oil, nor oil in exchange for ghee.”

key_terms.إِسْلَافُ: advance payment or forward sale arrangement
key_terms.السَّمْنِ: ghee or clarified butter as a commodity
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not proper or not appropriate in legal context
key_terms.لِلرَّجُلِ: for a man, meaning for a person engaging in the transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to advance ghee in exchange for oil, or oil in exchange for ghee, in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling discouraging or disallowing a salam-type advance exchange between ghee and oil. It relates to financial law and trade regulations concerning the exchange of food commodities of differing kinds.
